label: Reset rises at D1 after no reward, when S2 is believed good, and on reaching S1.
terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 0) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 2) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 0) * (prev_state == 2) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == 1) ;; (phase != D2) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D2) * (prev_state == 1)
explanation: Timing alone (high at GO, rising late in the episode) explains R^2 0.90. Beyond timing, the raw reset gate r of unit 1 goes up at D1 when the previous trial was unrewarded (+0.11, a bit more after two unrewarded trials in a row). It also goes up gradedly as the ideal observer leans toward S2 being good (negative belief_lo), and at D2 when S1 is the state reached (+0.07). The free fit adds the previous state being S1 at GO and D2 (+0.09 at GO), a small extra for prev_action a2 at D1, and the two-unrewarded-in-a-row term, which brings dev R^2 to 0.64 against 0.45 for the short form. Leftover misses are long runs of a2 choices landing on S1 unrewarded late in the episode, where the activation keeps climbing, so it behaves like an accumulator. No future variables are used.
